items.text: Following the successful release of City Transport Simulator 2026: Vienna Expansion, the biggest expansion for the game to date, we're releasing a hotfix today that addresses numerous minor issues in both Vienna and Tramau.
Passenger and pedestrian behavior in Vienna has been improved. Waiting passengers and those who have just exited a vehicle are now less likely to stray into the road and block buses and trams.
The honking behavior of AI vehicles has been improved. For example, they will no longer honk when the player is using their turn signals correctly.
The tolerance for the "Traffic signal violation" warning in Vienna has been adjusted to match Tramau.
Nighttime lighting conditions in Tramau have been improved. Additional streetlights have been added to several particularly dark areas. Further improvements are already in progress.
The visibility of the headlight beams on the Citybus C2 has been improved.
The low-beam headlight beams are now visible again on all Lion's City vehicles.
Fixed an issue where the required level to purchase a vehicle was not displayed in the marketplace in Career Mode.
Route numbers are now displayed correctly on the round route signs of the "Vienna" bus stop style in Tramau.
Fixed an issue where resetting the player or their vehicle could cause the game to get stuck on the loading screen.
Fixed various visual issues on the Vienna map.
Fixed several texture issues at bus stops in Tramau. Additional fixes are already in progress.
Adjusted the default steering wheel presets.
Turn signals can now be canceled on Moza steering wheels without having to activate the opposite turn signal first.
The bus stop style in Vienna can now also be changed on consoles.
This hotfix does not address all known issues yet. We're already working on the next hotfix, but we didn't want to keep you waiting any longer.

The next hotfix will include further improvements to the lighting conditions in Tramau, among other fixes. It will also address texture issues in Tramau and correct the incorrect name of the "Marsanogasse" stop in the Vienna Expansion menu.
[p align="start"]We released a new hotfix for City Transport Simulator: Tram.

[p align="start"]Hotfix v2026.1.1 includes several fixes, improvements, and optimizations related to the Tatra KT4D tram. The update focuses on audio, visuals, controls, gameplay behavior, and overall stability.
[p align="start"]Thank you very much for your feedback and bug reports. They help us improve the experience step by step.
Improved the 3D model of the Tatra KT4D pantograph.
Corrected the roof color of the Tatra KT4D to better match the original vehicle.
Announcements can now also be heard in the second vehicle of a Tatra KT4D double traction.
Adjusted the volume of the relay sounds of the Tatra KT4D.
Fixed an issue where the arc sound of the main contactor was not played.
The track speed is now correctly displayed and taken into account when driving the Tatra KT4D in double traction.
AI-controlled Tatra KT4D trams no longer roll backwards while standing still.
Fixed various issues related to the key bindings of the Tatra KT4D.
The displayed key binding for the Tatra KT4D door control is now shown correctly when using a gamepad.
The parking brake of the Tatra KT4D now only releases once the accelerator pedal is pressed.
Fixed crashes that could occur when placing the Tatra KT4D again.
Fixed crashes that could occur when a Tatra KT4D double traction entered the depot.
Fixed a freeze that could occur when using the door release and the control for opening all doors at the same time.
[p align="start"]We hope you enjoy the improved Tatra KT4D experience and wish you a great ride!

items.text: The latest update for City Transport Simulator 2026 is now available and brings improvements for steering wheels, weather options, stops, performance, and various bug fixes.
Steering wheel support has been further improved. Force feedback settings can now be configured individually for each input device or steering wheel, allowing for much more flexible setups.

In addition, default profiles have been added for supported and tested steering wheels from various manufacturers. There is also a new option that allows steering wheel settings to be reset to their default values at any time.
The line editor now supports circular routes. Lines can now start and end at the same stop, making closed loop routes possible.
The display of player avatars in the personalization menu has also been improved, and a weather adjustment option has been added to the pause menu.
Key binding options have been expanded. Newly assignable options include:
Left and right turn signals for Moza and Aerosoft steering wheels
Parking lights
Low beam headlights
Headlights off
Various windshield wiper modes and wiper levels
Brake release button for E1 Geamatic
Second bell or horn
Ticket machine camera
Windshield heating
Buses and trams can now have different platform numbers at the same stop. In addition, platform numbering has been adjusted at various stops.
Map assets in the Torijama Allee area have been optimized to improve performance.
The behavior of AI vehicles, as well as passenger pathfinding at tram and bus stops, has been improved.
Passenger numbers at stops have also been adjusted so that less frequently used stops feel more lively and passengers board your own line more reliably.
The intersection at Marcoplatz has been reworked so that bus traffic is no longer blocked or disrupted there.
At temperatures below freezing, snow is now correctly displayed instead of rain.
Trips after 11:00 PM can once again be selected as intended when starting the game.
With dynamic weather, rain sounds are no longer played when clear weather is active.
In free exploration, navigation arrows and switch controls now work correctly again after taking over a vehicle.
The passenger information display now shows the correct departures again and no longer incorrectly reports “No departures”.
The steering wheel improvements are now also available on consoles. Individual configurations for each steering wheel are now possible there as well.

The optimization of map assets in the Torijama Allee area has also fixed related crashes. Tram signal boards have been reworked so that they become visible earlier and are displayed more sharply at close range.
